---
name: Heritage
description: A calm editorial look
colors:
  primary: "#1A1C1E"
  secondary: "#6C7278"
  tertiary: "#B8422E"
  neutral: "#F7F5F2"
  on-tertiary: "{colors.neutral}"
typography:
  h1:
    fontFamily: Public Sans
    fontSize: 3rem
    fontWeight: 600
    lineHeight: 1.1
    letterSpacing: -0.02em
  body-md:
    fontFamily: Public Sans
    fontSize: 1rem
    fontWeight: 400
    lineHeight: 1.6
rounded:
  sm: 4px
  md: 8px
spacing:
  sm: 8px
  md: 16px
components:
  button-primary:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.tertiary}"
    textColor: "{colors.on-tertiary}"
    rounded: "{rounded.sm}"
    padding: 12px
  button-primary-hover:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.primary}"
omitted: [do-and-donts]
---

## Overview

Architectural minimalism meets journalistic gravitas.

## Colors

* **Deep Ink (#1A1C1E):** Headlines and core text.
* **Slate (#6C7278):** Captions and borders.
* **Boston Clay (#B8422E):** The one call to action per screen.
* **neutral:** Page background.

## Typography

Public Sans for everything.

## Layout

An 8px rhythm.

## Components

Buttons are rectangular with a 4px radius.

## Do's and Don'ts

* Do use the clay once per screen.
